summary: Phase C (Partner API v1 Creative Library + Multi-Format Campaigns) is fully green — 41/41 pytest cases PASS against the external URL. Verified: POST /creatives (asset_url→'ready', no url→'processing'; Idempotency-Key returns the same crv_ id ignoring later body changes; external_id de-dupes across different idem keys). Validation: image size_bytes=6MB → 400 file_too_large, type='nope' → 400 invalid_creative_type, audio duration_seconds=120 → 400 duration_exceeds_max. GET /creatives cursor pagination returns disjoint pages, garbage cursor → 400 invalid_cursor, type + external_id filters narrow correctly. PATCH updates name/click_url and persists; invalid status → 400 invalid_status. DELETE soft-deletes (status='deleted' on subsequent GET). POST /creatives/upload-url returns a REAL Tigris presigned PUT (host fly.storage.tigris.dev, method=PUT, Content-Type header, finalize_url pointing to /api/v1/creatives/{id}/finalize) and creates a shell with status='uploading' + asset_key; finalize without an uploaded object → 409 asset_not_found; upload-url rejects mime/type mismatch. SSRF-safe import: http:// → 400 import_url_must_be_https; https://localhost/ → 400 (blocked_host); https://127.0.0.1/ → 400 import_url_private_or_unresolvable. Multi-format POST /campaigns with only line_items[] (no top-level product) → 201 with parent_campaign_id (pcmp_…), multi_format:true, status='active' (sandbox auto-activates), each line item carries underlying_campaign_id + status='active'; GET /campaigns/{parent_id}/line-items returns parent + line_items[]; a push_notification (unbookable) line item alongside a valid audio_preroll → line item status='unsupported' with error.code='product_not_bookable_via_api' while the audio_preroll line item + the parent still activate (partial success); parent 'pcmp_doesnotexist' → 404. Single-format still works. Providing neither product nor line_items → 400 product_required. capabilities.feature_flags now show creative_library=true and multi_format_campaigns=true. Phase A regression (/status,/inventory,/markets,/rate-card,/me,/products,/openapi.json,/capabilities,/stations cursor) and Phase B (/quotes audio_preroll+dubai+morning_drive returns effective_rate_cents=4680; error envelope keeps legacy `detail`) all pass.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/partner_api_v1.py::_create_multiformat does NOT propagate top-level pricing_model / cpm_bid_cents / cpc_bid_cents to line items that omit their own. A caller who sends only {type, creative_ids} for an audio_preroll line item gets status='error' with error.code='line_item_create_failed' (the underlying engine rejects the missing bid). This makes the API surface feel inconsistent vs. single-format (which accepts a top-level pricing_model default). Recommend inheriting li.pricing_model = li.pricing_model or body.pricing_model, same for cpm/cpc bids, and documenting the fallback in the OpenAPI description of LineItem.

routes/partner_api_v1.py::finalize_creative — the 409 path sets status='error' before raising asset_not_found, so a retry of /finalize on the same creative will hit the SAME 409 (head still empty) and toggle to 'error' each time. Consider only marking 'error' on a validation failure inside finalize (post-head), not on the empty-object case; the empty-object case should remain 'uploading' so the partner can retry the PUT.

services/partner_creatives.py::signed_upload local-dev fallback returns an in-app path (/api/storage/local/{key}) that is NOT a real presigned PUT — fine for STORAGE_BACKEND=tigris (current setup), but if a partner ever runs against a local backend, the client library will try to PUT there and silently succeed against a non-existent route. Prefer returning 501 or a clear flag partners can key off.

services/partner_creatives.py::validate_metadata for html only checks mime/exts/size — no CSP/script-scan. Phase C copy says 'scan' but this is a metadata-only validator today. Worth noting so partners don't assume ad-safety.

routes/partner_api_v1.py::list_creatives fetches .limit(500) then paginates in-memory (via ext.paginate). Same limitation flagged for /campaigns and /sponsorships in iter121. Partners with >500 creatives will silently truncate. Move cursoring into the underlying Mongo query.

routes/partner_api_v1.py::create_creative — if body.asset_url is provided the status is set to 'ready' with NO server-side reachability / mime probing. A partner can point asset_url at a garbage URL and the creative will still be 'ready' and usable by campaigns. Consider a HEAD probe on trusted https URLs, or leaving asset_url'd creatives in 'processing' until validated.

routes/partner_api_v1.py::delete_creative marks status='deleted' but does not prevent the creative from being referenced by /campaigns line_items on subsequent creates; there is no engine-side check that creative_ids point at non-deleted creatives. Consider filtering out deleted creatives in _create_multiformat and returning a warning per line item.
seed_data_creation: TEST_-prefixed advertiser + several image/audio creatives (some with asset_url, some 'processing', a few 'uploading' shells left un-finalized) + 2 multi-format parent campaigns + 1 single-format audio_preroll campaign under the sandbox partner. Idempotency-Key + external-id mappings TTL as per Phase B (7d idempotency).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase C is green end-to-end. STORAGE_BACKEND=tigris so /creatives/upload-url returns a REAL presigned S3 PUT on fly.storage.tigris.dev with 15-min TTL — verifying an end-to-end upload+finalize→'ready' path is out of scope for the sandbox test suite (would need to actually PUT bytes to Tigris); the 409 asset_not_found path IS verified. Multi-format line items call services.ad1_advertiser_service.create_campaign per bookable line item and link them via parent_campaign_id; unbookable products (push_notification, coupon_promotion, retargeting, …) intentionally get status='unsupported' — parent still activates. Line items DO NOT inherit top-level pricing_model / bids — pass them per-line-item or expect status='error'. Library creatives live in db.creative_assets; parents in db.api_parent_campaigns; line items in db.campaign_line_items. Error envelope keeps legacy `detail` throughout.
